headline: Approved 14 police and school vehicle purchases, $575,000 in road salt, and wastewater consulting contracts; tabled High Street and School Street garage leases.
summary: Most approved spending was for police vehicles, including an armored SWAT vehicle and a prisoner transport van. Approved a biodiesel fuel contract for Nashua Transit. A sewer and drain flow monitoring system contract was tabled.
decisions: Placed on file a communication about replacing hybrid police vehicles.
